name: Xfinity (Comcast)
why: Introductory rates expire and bills creep up each year. Retention reps can re-price you or add a price guarantee, and a fiber or fixed-wireless competitor at your address gives you real leverage.

haggle.leverage: Your promotional rate has ended or just rose, a competing fiber or fixed-wireless offer exists at your address, and you are willing to disconnect. The retention department can apply credits that front-line reps cannot.
haggle.script: Hi, I have been an Xfinity customer for [N] years and my bill has gone up to $[X] a month. I would like to stay, but [AT&T Fiber / Frontier / T-Mobile Home Internet] has quoted me $[Y] a month with a price lock. Can you move me to your current new-customer rate or a plan with a multi-year price guarantee? Please also check whether I can use my own modem instead of renting one. Before we change anything, I need the total monthly price with equipment, taxes and fees. If you cannot get close, please tell me how to disconnect and return equipment.
haggle.bestTime: Within 30 days before a promotion ends or right after a price increase. Ask for the retention or disconnect department rather than general support.

cancel.howTo: Xfinity's cancel page lists three routes: call 1-800-934-6489, schedule a call from the page, or visit an Xfinity Store. If you have Xfinity Mobile, move your number to the new carrier before you cancel. Return rented equipment at a store or by the instructions you are given.
cancel.gotchas: Expect a retention offer before the cancellation is processed, so ask for the exact last day of service. If you signed a term or price-guarantee agreement, check for an early termination fee. NOW Internet is canceled separately in the NOW portal.

why: Spectrum lists first-year promotional prices and then moves you to standard rates. A call before the promo ends, with a named competitor offer, is the cheapest way to hold the price down.

haggle.leverage: The first-year promotional price is ending, a competitor serves your address at a lower price, and Spectrum's own page promises no contracts, so leaving costs you nothing in fees.
haggle.script: Hello, I have been a Spectrum internet customer for [N] years and my promotional rate ended, so my bill is now $[X]. I would like to keep service, but [AT&T Fiber / Frontier / T-Mobile Home Internet] quoted me $[Y] a month with a price lock. Can you extend my promotional pricing or move me to a plan close to that price? Please tell me the total monthly cost with equipment, taxes and fees, and how long the price is guaranteed. haggle.bestTime: Before a device-payment promotion credit runs out, or right after a notice of a price or fee increase.

cancel.howTo: Mobile: call 800-922-0204 with the account owner's name, number and PIN, or sign in to My Verizon, open chat and type "Cancel". Fios under a term can carry an early termination fee (up to $350, falling by $15 a month per Verizon's page), and rented equipment must come back within 30 days. A pending mobile disconnect can be cancelled until the day before it takes effect.

name: GEICO
why: Auto premiums rise at most renewals and rates differ a lot between carriers for the same driver. Get comparable quotes, ask GEICO to re-rate you, and switch only if a rival is clearly cheaper.

alternatives.name: NAIC consumer insurance resources
alternatives.note: Neutral guidance on comparing quotes and your state regulator if a claim or cancellation goes wrong.

haggle.leverage: Competing quotes with identical coverage limits and deductibles, a clean record, bundling, paying in full, and telematics or safe-driver programs. A new quote from a rival is the one lever that works at every carrier.
haggle.script: Hello, I am reviewing my policy with GEICO before renewal. My premium is $[X] and I have quotes from Progressive and State Farm at $[Y] for the same coverage limits. I would like to stay if we can lower it. Can you check for unapplied discounts such as bundling, multi-car, paid in full, safe-driver or telematics, paperless, good student and affinity or employer, and show me deductible options? Please re-rate me against my current driving record and give me the new premium and what changes in writing.
haggle.bestTime: 30 to 45 days before renewal, once you hold two or three quotes with identical coverage limits. Do not cancel the old policy until the new one is active.

cancel.howTo: Call GEICO at (800) 841-1587 and speak to a licensed agent, or say "cancel insurance policy" and then "auto" at the automated prompt. Have the policy number ready and ask for written confirmation of the end date.
cancel.gotchas: Buy the new policy first so you have no gap in coverage. GEICO says there is no cancellation fee, except that North Carolina policies may use a short-rate calculation. Refund rules vary by state, and some states want proof of other coverage or returned plates before a refund.

why: Lemonade prices are set by its app, with little room to negotiate by phone. Your levers are raising the deductible, bundling products and comparing a rival quote at renewal.

alternatives.name: NAIC consumer insurance resources
alternatives.note: Neutral guidance on comparing quotes and your state regulator if a claim or cancellation goes wrong.

haggle.leverage: Lemonade quotes are algorithmic, so the realistic levers are deductible and coverage settings, bundling renters or home with car, and a rival quote.
haggle.script: Hello, I am reviewing my Lemonade policy before renewal. I pay $[X] a month and I have a quote from [competitor] at $[Y] for the same coverage. I would like to stay if possible. Could you check whether a higher deductible, a bundle with my other Lemonade policies, or any discount that I do not have applied would lower my premium? Please tell me the new monthly price and what coverage changes with it, and send that to me in writing so I can compare it with the other quote.
haggle.bestTime: Before renewal, after you have a rival quote. Use the in-app chat and ask for a written re-quote.

cancel.howTo: Cancel any time in the Lemonade app; renters policies can also be canceled on the website. Lemonade's FAQ promises a refund for the unused paid period and lists no cancellation fee.
cancel.gotchas: Canceling a pet policy ends any Giveback tied to it, and illnesses diagnosed under the old policy count as pre-existing if you return. Start your replacement policy first so there is no gap.

name: USAA Insurance
why: USAA is only open to military members, veterans and their families, and it prices well for many of them but not all. Re-quote every renewal and use the result to ask for a re-rate.

alternatives.name: NAIC consumer insurance resources
alternatives.note: Neutral guidance on comparing quotes and your state regulator if a claim or cancellation goes wrong.

haggle.leverage: Competing quotes with identical coverage limits and deductibles, a clean record, bundling, paying in full, and telematics or safe-driver programs. A new quote from a rival is the one lever that works at every carrier. USAA membership is limited, so make sure the rival quote reflects any military or garaging discounts you already get.
haggle.script: Hello, I am reviewing my policy with USAA before renewal. My premium is $[X] and I have quotes from GEICO and Progressive at $[Y] for the same coverage limits. I would like to stay if we can lower it. Can you check for unapplied discounts such as bundling, multi-car, paid in full, safe-driver or telematics, paperless, good student and affinity or employer, and show me deductible options? Please re-rate me against my current driving record and give me the new premium and what changes in writing.
haggle.bestTime: 30 to 45 days before renewal, once you hold two or three quotes with identical coverage limits. Do not cancel the old policy until the new one is active.

cancel.howTo: Contact USAA through the number on your policy documents or the USAA app and ask for the end date to match your new policy. USAA's current published cancellation steps were not confirmed for this entry, so check them on usaa.com before you act.
cancel.gotchas: Leaving USAA insurance does not close your USAA bank account, but check for discounts tied to holding both. Start the new policy first, and get written confirmation of the cancellation date and any refund.

name: YNAB (You Need A Budget)
why: YNAB's method is envelope budgeting, and Actual Budget is a mature open-source tool built on the same idea. It imports YNAB exports, so the switch is a weekend project. Bank sync is the main thing you give up.

alternatives.name: Actual Budget
alternatives.note: Free, open-source envelope budgeting you can run locally or self-host.

alternatives.name: Goodbudget
alternatives.note: Envelope budgeting app with a free tier that works from manual entry.

selfhost.youLose: Automatic bank connections: in the US, Actual syncs through SimpleFIN Bridge, a separate paid service you sign up for, or you import CSV files by hand. There is no native phone app, only a web app. YNAB's support and teaching content are gone. You handle updates and backups, and credit card payment categories do not map one for one on import. The cost figure adds about $15 a year for SimpleFIN Bridge.
selfhost.prompt: I am running you on the target machine (or over SSH to it); confirm that before changing anything. I want to replace my YNAB subscription with a self-hosted Actual Budget server. Target device: a Raspberry Pi 4 or 5, or an old laptop, running 64-bit Linux with Docker and Tailscale. Install Docker and Compose, then create a docker-compose.yml that runs actualbudget/actual-server with the latest-alpine tag, port 5006 and a persistent /data volume, restarting automatically. Install Tailscale and use tailscale serve so I can open Actual over HTTPS from my phone and laptop without exposing a port. Set a strong server password on first run. Add a nightly cron job that copies /data to a USB drive and keeps 14 days, a monthly restic copy to a second location, and an update script that can roll back. Finally, walk me through exporting my YNAB plan as JSON with a personal access token and importing it through Switch file, Import file, nYNAB, fixing a not-ynab5 error if it appears, then list the categories to clean up afterwards.

rebuild.whatYouBuild: An offline envelope-budgeting PWA with accounts (including credit cards), transfers and split transactions, monthly category groups, rollover, CSV import from your bank, scheduled transactions and a spending report.
rebuild.runsOn: Installable PWA on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages free tier, with data in IndexedDB on your device.
rebuild.youLose: Automatic bank sync (CSV import only), sync between devices except by exporting a JSON backup, YNAB's support and teaching, and polish. Budget math has to be tested carefully because mistakes are yours to find. Credit card handling is the hardest part and the place a budget goes quietly wrong.
rebuild.prompt: Build me a free, offline envelope budgeting app to replace YNAB, as an installable PWA with Vite, React and TypeScript and all data in IndexedDB. Core features: 1) accounts with a running balance, including credit card accounts, where spending moves money from the category to a payment category; 2) category groups with Assigned, Activity and Available per month, rollover and overspending flags; 3) quick entry, transfers between accounts, split transactions, and CSV import from my bank with column mapping and duplicate detection; 4) scheduled transactions; 5) a Ready to Assign banner and a spending-by-category report; 6) JSON export and import. Include an importer for YNAB's Register.csv and budget CSV that handles its "Transfer : Account" payees and splits. Write Vitest tests for the budget math, especially rollover, overspending, credit card payments, transfers and splits. Deploy free to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages, explain installing it on my phone, and write a README.

cancel.howTo: Sign in at app.ynab.com/settings, scroll to Cancel your subscription and confirm. Cancellation takes effect at the end of your billing period. On a phone, billing settings are only in the web browser. If you subscribed through the App Store or Google Play, cancel in that store instead.
cancel.gotchas: The annual plan renews automatically for a year at a time, so cancel before the renewal date. YNAB gives no retroactive refunds. Export your plan data first if you want to import it into another tool.

name: Monarch Money
why: Actual Budget with SimpleFIN sync covers budgeting only. You lose investment tracking, net worth, polished reports and partner sharing. Keep Monarch if those matter; self-host only for plain spending.

alternatives.name: Actual Budget
alternatives.note: Free, open-source envelope budgeting you can run locally or self-host.

alternatives.name: SimpleFIN Bridge
alternatives.note: The bank-connection service Actual Budget uses for US accounts; it is a separate paid subscription.

alternatives.name: Empower
alternatives.note: Free net-worth and investment tracking dashboard, supported by advisory sales.

selfhost.youLose: Investment and net-worth tracking, Monarch's categorization and report polish, and its partner-sharing interface. SimpleFIN Bridge is a separate paid service; the cost figure here adds about $15 a year for it on top of power, so check its current price. Sync keys are stored on your server without end-to-end encryption.
selfhost.prompt: I am running you on the target machine (or over SSH to it); confirm that before changing anything. Set up a self-hosted replacement for Monarch Money using Actual Budget. Target: an old laptop running Ubuntu Server 24.04, or a Raspberry Pi 5, with Docker and Tailscale. Steps: install Docker, run actualbudget/actual-server with a persistent /data volume and automatic restarts, expose it on my tailnet over HTTPS with tailscale serve, and set a server password. Then help me connect bank sync with SimpleFIN Bridge for my US accounts: explain how to create the SimpleFIN account, generate the setup token and add it in Actual, and warn me that sync keys are stored on the server unencrypted, so I should lock down disk access and backups. Show me how to import my Monarch transactions CSV export, build category rules from my existing categories, and recreate my top three reports. Add nightly backups of /data to an external drive with 30-day retention and test a restore. Finish with a checklist of what Monarch did that Actual will not, such as investment tracking.

cancel.howTo: Monarch says you can cancel anytime. Sign in on the web and open your subscription or billing settings to cancel; if you subscribed through the Apple App Store or Google Play, cancel in that store instead. Download your transactions as CSV before you leave.
cancel.gotchas: Promo codes apply only to annual Core plans billed directly by Monarch, not through Apple or Google. The pricing page advertises a no-questions-asked money-back guarantee, so ask about the window before you pay for an annual plan.

name: Rocket Money Premium
why: Premium mostly sells subscription tracking and cancellation help. A local tracker built from monthly CSV downloads does the tracking part free; you do the cancelling and haggling yourself.

alternatives.name: Rocket Money free tier
alternatives.note: The free plan lists recurring subscriptions; Premium adds cancellation help and negotiation.

alternatives.name: Actual Budget
alternatives.note: Free, open-source envelope budgeting you can run locally or self-host.

rebuild.whatYouBuild: A private subscription tracker: drop bank CSVs, detect recurring charges, flag price hikes and stopped charges, store keep/cancel/haggle decisions and renewal dates, and export reminders to your calendar.
rebuild.runsOn: Installable PWA on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages free tier, with data in IndexedDB; nothing leaves your device.
rebuild.youLose: Automatic bank sync (you drop a CSV each month), concierge cancellation, bill negotiation, credit score tools and phone alerts when a new charge appears.
rebuild.prompt: Build me a private subscription tracker to replace Rocket Money Premium. Make it an installable PWA using Vite, React and TypeScript, with all data stored in IndexedDB and nothing uploaded anywhere. Features: 1) drop one or more bank or credit card CSV files and parse them in the browser with PapaParse, handling common column names and date formats; 2) detect recurring charges by merchant, cadence and amount stability, and show the annual cost of each; 3) flag price increases and charges that stopped; 4) let me mark each subscription as keep, cancel or haggle, add a renewal date and notes, and export upcoming renewals as an .ics calendar file; 5) a cancel checklist per service with a link field; 6) JSON export and import for backup. Add Vitest tests with a sample statement fixture. Deploy it free on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages, and write a README that explains how to download CSVs from my bank each month.

cancel.howTo: Rocket Money's help center has a Premium Membership collection that covers managing and cancelling your membership; start there, or check the account settings in the app. If you subscribed through the App Store or Google Play, cancel there as well.
cancel.gotchas: Check the app for any fee on bill-negotiation savings before you use that feature, and confirm the cancellation completes before your next billing date.

name: Copilot Money
why: The value is a polished Apple-first app with bank sync. Actual Budget can do the budgeting for free, but it is plainer and needs a home server, so keep Copilot unless the price bothers you.

alternatives.name: Actual Budget
alternatives.note: Free, open-source envelope budgeting you can run locally or self-host.

alternatives.name: Goodbudget
alternatives.note: Envelope budgeting app with a free tier that works from manual entry.

selfhost.youLose: Automatic bank connections unless you add a paid SimpleFIN Bridge account, Copilot's iOS design and widgets, its investment views, and its smart categorization. You also own updates and backups. The cost figure adds about $15 a year for SimpleFIN Bridge.
selfhost.prompt: I am running you on the target machine (or over SSH to it); confirm that before changing anything. Help me move off Copilot Money to a self-hosted Actual Budget server. Target: an old laptop or Raspberry Pi running Linux with Docker, plus Tailscale so my iPhone can reach it. Please set up actualbudget/actual-server with a persistent data volume, restart policy and a strong password, then publish it to my tailnet over HTTPS with tailscale serve and walk me through adding the site to my iPhone home screen as a web app. Next, guide me through exporting my transactions from Copilot as CSV and importing them into Actual: map date, name, amount and category, create matching categories, and write rules so recurring merchants are categorized automatically. Set up nightly backups of the data folder to an external disk. Finally, list plainly what I give up compared with Copilot, such as automatic bank connections, investment tracking and its iOS design, and suggest a manual weekly routine to keep transactions up to date by CSV.

cancel.howTo: If you subscribed through the App Store, cancel in iPhone Settings, then your name, then Subscriptions. If you subscribed on the web, open the account or subscription settings on copilot.money. Export your transactions before you leave.
cancel.gotchas: The annual plan renews each year, so cancel before the renewal date. App Store and web subscriptions are managed in different places, so check where your charge appears (APPLE.COM/BILL or COPILOT MONEY) before you look for the cancel button.

name: Quicken Simplifi
why: Simplifi advertises $3.99 a month billed annually for the first year against a $6.99 list price, then renews at the then-current rate. Ask for the new-member price at renewal, or cancel.

alternatives.name: Actual Budget
alternatives.note: Free, open-source envelope budgeting you can run locally or self-host.

haggle.leverage: The first-year offer is for new memberships, and the page says renewal uses the then-current rate. Your leverage is that you can cancel and your data exports to CSV.
haggle.script: Hello, my Simplifi annual membership renews on [date] and I see the price is going up to $[X]. I paid $[Y] last year under the new-member offer. I like the product and would like to continue, but I am comparing it with a free alternative. Can you apply the current new-member price or a renewal discount to my account? If not, please confirm the exact renewal date and amount so I can cancel before I am charged. Please confirm the outcome in writing.
haggle.bestTime: Two to three weeks before your renewal date. Use chat or phone support, and have your renewal date and last price ready.

cancel.howTo: Quicken says you can manage your subscription at your My Account page (myaccount.quicken.com) and can cancel before your renewal date. Export your data first.
cancel.gotchas: Offers on the page apply to first-year memberships ordered directly from Quicken; after that the subscription renews at the then-current rate. A refund window was not confirmed for this entry, so check the Quicken terms before an annual purchase.

why: Paid credit monitoring mostly repeats what is free: weekly reports at annualcreditreport.com, free credit freezes and card-issuer alerts. Keep it only if you want the identity-theft insurance and three-bureau alerts.

alternatives.name: FTC: free credit reports
alternatives.note: Explains your free report rights and how to dispute errors.

cancel.howTo: Sign in to your Experian account and open your membership settings to cancel or switch to the free plan; Experian says you can change plan, cancel or downgrade to free at any time. If you cannot find it, use Experian's help center or call the number on your statement.
cancel.gotchas: If you use CreditLock, cancelling the paid plan unlocks your credit file at the end of the billing period, so place a free credit freeze at all three bureaus first if you still want protection. Experian's plans page lists Core, Plus and Premium, and your statement may still say CreditWorks, so check which plan you are paying for.
